system_overview: clinic-queue-board is a walk-in clinic queue display with SMS notify. It is built as a small focused system with Check-in Kiosk at its core, supported by Queue "fast lane" Manager and SMS Notifier (Twilio).

recommended_language.rationale: TypeScript fits the walk-in clinic queue display with SMS notify workload on technical grounds.

quality_goals.goal: Correct output under normal failure modes

architecture_decisions.title: Use Check-in Kiosk as the system core
architecture_decisions.rationale: The walk-in clinic queue display with SMS notify hinges on this component working well.

positive: Single place to harden the critical path
negative: Core component becomes a bottleneck for change

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Operational overhead for a small system.

architecture_decisions.title: Run SMS Notifier (Twilio) asynchronously
architecture_decisions.rationale: Keeps the interactive path fast on modest hardware.

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Ties user latency to slow external work.

what_not_to_build: A plugin system before there are users

risk_flags.risk: External dependency outage stalls the async path
risk_flags.mitigation: Retry with backoff and a dead-letter table.

open_questions: What is the realistic peak concurrent usage?
constraints: Entities Patient, Visit, QueueSlot must persist relationally
Components: Check-in Kiosk, Queue "fast lane" Manager, SMS Notifier (Twilio)
